settings.heading: Shipping
settings.content: Orders process in 1–2 business days. Standard US delivery takes 7–12 business days after dispatch. Tracking is emailed when the carrier accepts the parcel.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Request a return within 30 days of delivery. Opened products are eligible when all components are included and there is no damage beyond normal trial use. Return shipping is deducted unless the item arrived damaged, defective, or incorrect.

settings.heading: Product FAQ
settings.content: New to resistance training? Start light and move slowly. Returning after injury? Ask a qualified professional whether this product suits your circumstances. Fitness outcomes vary; no result is guaranteed.
